title: LootHistory — ledger correctness, perf and architecture
cluster_summary: All findings are local to LootHistory and no upstream route applies. The only code changes needed are: add the one-line idempotent-publish guard to AnalyticsCharts.lua, and move PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED out of the ledgerEvent perf bracket, which a test pins. The Escrow, Timeline and Panel load-time reads stay where they are; their TOC lines are annotated LOAD-BEARING under LH-78..81, and the auction-exit labelling is documented in ARCHITECTURE.md Known limitations. LED-P2-01..24 is an owner-only release gate that blocks any version bump. The coalescing map is accepted, the location-string parser unification is optional, and the logo path finding is refuted as a rule breach.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: AnalyticsCharts.lua:2 is the only Analytics* file without `NS.Analytics = NS.Analytics or {}`. Escrow appends to R.SCAN_STEPS/R.PLAN_STEPS at load, Timeline reads TM.TOTAL at load and Panel reads MASTER_GROUP at load. These depend on TOC order, which is deterministic and correct. Only Escrow's mutation really fits the SHOULD NOT, and refactoring it into an init hook would put ledger step ordering at risk for no gain.
verdicts.remediation: Add `NS.Analytics = NS.Analytics or {}` at modules/AnalyticsCharts.lua:2. Leave Escrow's step registration, Timeline's TM.TOTAL read and Panel's MASTER_GROUP read in place, and annotate their TOC lines LOAD-BEARING (as part of LH-78..81) naming the dependency: Reconciler, TimelineModel and Schema respectively.

verdicts.assessment: library-stack-§8 binds arguments passed to the LibKa0s-Media seam, not the addon's own landing-page art path, so no rule is breached. Renaming the folder would break SavedVariables anyway.

All 24 LED-P2 Result fields are blank, but the doc's sign-off requires them. trackLedger defaults to true, so a wrong client assumption would persist bad rows account-wide. The feature is unreleased. This is an owner-run in-client release gate, not an agent task.
verdicts.remediation: Record LED-P2-01..24 in the bundle's smoke-test file as an open owner smoke item. The owner runs them and records the results; the agent never marks one passed. After the owner records a pass for LED-P2-06, update the AttributionOut.lua:64-65 comment to cite it. Block any version bump or release until all 24 are recorded.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: the PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED branch runs LoginScan/Flush synchronously inside the ledgerEvent bracket, which contradicts the comment at Reconciler.lua:119-120 and the PerfSetup bucket declaration. A perf capture would charge the cost to the wrong bucket. The fix is cheap and testable.
verdicts.remediation: In R:OnEvent, handle PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED before the Perf bracket, for example with an unbracketed onRegenEnabled. Add a tests/test_perf.lua case asserting that regen produces no ledgerEvent sample while BAG_UPDATE still does.

verdicts.assessment: Both effects are real: commitExits overwrites the shared ts, and one sale mail books every pending exit as AH_SOLD. Net counts are correct; only the reason labels are wrong, and fixing the code needs a schema migration. documentation-§3 puts Known limitations in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (:437), not docs/data-flow.md.
verdicts.remediation: Add a known-limitation bullet to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md '## Known limitations' naming both effects: the shared ts restarting the exit TTL, and one sale mail booking all pending exits of the item as AH_SOLD. Optionally cross-reference it from the Exit paragraph in docs/data-flow.md. No code change.

verdicts.assessment: R.recent grows with the number of distinct coalescing keys per session, not with event count, and is cleared on DisableCapture or reload. The memory involved is negligible.

The two parsers split at the first and the last '/', and they agree only because no holder key contains '/'. There is no impact today. NS.Ledger loads before TimelineModel, so swapping the parser is zero-risk.
verdicts.remediation: Replace TimelineModel's local sideOf (:156) with NS.Ledger.LocationHolder.
